qualification.details: Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Ayurveda: Essential: BAMS from a recognized University/Institution. Desirable: Post-graduate degree (MD/MS in Ayurveda). Prior research experience in integrative clinical trials, handling clinical research forms, or published work in Pub Med/SCOPUS indexed journals. Project Nurse III: Essential: Four year nursing course from a recognized institute or MSc Nursing from a recognized university with valid registration with any state nursing council. Desirable: Experience in handling clinical trial patients, blood sampling, and drug administration in institutional setting or NTEP programme. Computer literacy for patient logging and record maintenance. Project Technical Support III (MSW): Essential: Three years graduate in sociology or social work or any other relevant discipline from a recognized university + 3 years of relevant field/community/research experience after graduation or PG in sociology or social work or any other relevant discipline from a recognized university. Desirable: Prior experience in community-based research projects, public health programs, or clinical hospital setups or NTEP programme. Fluency in local language, Hindi and English. Project Technical Support I (Lab technician): Essential: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + two years experience in lab work or Three years graduate degree in relevant subject/field + one year experience in lab work. Desirable: Experience of biological sample collection, processing, Storage and cold-chain maintenance. Experience handling laboratory equipment. Basic computer skills for sample logging and data reporting.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment is scheduled for 25 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur has announced a total of 6 vacancies for various posts including Senior Research Fellow (SRF) – Ayurveda, Project Nurse-III, Project Technical Support- III (MSW), and Project Technical Support- I (Lab technician).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) – Ayurveda post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) – Ayurveda post is BAMS from a recognized University/Institution. A postgraduate degree (MD/MS in Ayurveda) and prior research experience are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts announced by AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced by AIIMS Jodhpur is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) – Ayurveda post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) – Ayurveda post is Rs. 42000/ + HRA, Rs. 28000/ + HRA, or Rs. 18000/ + HRA, depending on the specific criteria and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview. A Screening/Scrutiny Test may also be conducted if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan, 342005. Candidates should report to the specified venue on the interview date.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions announced by AIIMS Jodhpur are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.
